text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I accidentally pulled another all-nighter 
today... Training research really is so 
profoundly deep...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Body conditioning, nutritional 
replenishment, and vocal training. To 
achieve the maximum results in our limited 
time—

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
—Ah! I-I think I got an inspiration...!? 
Holding baked carrots and maracas... 
running outside the academy while singing!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Singing and running, one-two! If you get 
hungry, munch on a roasted carrot! Holding 
items in both hands keeps your center of 
gravity stable... Perfect!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoa... Oops, no, no! First, I need to 
test it on myself right away—!"

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, stop. Running while carrying 
all that... is dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ! Meek... You might have a point there.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
"...Not trying to do everything at once. 
One step at a time... together. 
...Forever, with you, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...So, first of all, let's sleep together.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Meek... Ah, but... there are still about 
five books I'd like to finish reading 
today—

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
Hm... In that case, I will read it to you. 
Myself.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
Something like this. "Anaerobic... 
energy... generation methods... The 
fundamentals of... anaerobic exercise..."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I'm... I'm... totally gonna fall 
asleep...!
